# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from realm/config/loader.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

A game is configured by `config.py` in its game directory. Every key below is
optional; an unset key takes its default. A relative path is resolved against
the game directory. A key that is a near miss of a real one (`WELCOME_BANER`)
logs a warning at boot, because it would otherwise be ignored. Other UPPERCASE
names are yours: `init_world` can read them with `server.settings.get("NAME")`.

## Keys

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GAME_NAME` | `'REALM'` | Name shown on the welcome screen and in logs. |
| `DEBUG` | `False` | Log at DEBUG level (same as `realm start --debug`). |
| `GAME_SYSTEM` | `'realm.games.gurps.system.GurpsSystem'` | Dotted import path to the GameSystem subclass that holds the rules (chargen, checks, advancement, combat pairing, currency). Choose it once, before the first character is created. |
| `DAMAGE_POOL` | `'hp'` | The pool harm lands in first, for an object that does not set its own `damage_pool` attribute (docs/guides/pools.md). |
| `ENCODING` | `'utf-8'` | Text encoding for telnet input and output (`latin-1` or `cp437` only for legacy clients). |
| `TELNET_HOST` | `'0.0.0.0'` | Telnet listen address. |
| `TELNET_PORT` | `4000` | Telnet listen port. |
| `WEBSOCKET_HOST` | `'0.0.0.0'` | WebSocket listen address. |
| `WEBSOCKET_PORT` | `4001` | WebSocket listen port. |
| `ENABLE_TELNET` | `True` | Run the telnet server. |
| `ENABLE_WEBSOCKET` | `False` | Run the WebSocket server (needs aiohttp). |
| `ENABLE_SCRIPTING` | `True` | Run softcode: `$`-commands, `^`-listens, `ON_<EVENT>` hooks, inline blocks. |
| `INLINE_OPEN` | `'[['` | Opening delimiter of an inline softcode block in text. |
| `INLINE_CLOSE` | `']]'` | Closing delimiter of an inline softcode block in text. Differs from INLINE_OPEN. |
| `COMMAND_SIGIL` | `'$'` | Prefix of a softcode command attribute (`$greet *:...`). No `:`. |
| `LISTEN_SIGIL` | `'^'` | Prefix of a softcode listen attribute (`^*hello*:...`). No `:`. |
| `MARKUP_MARKER` | `'\|'` | Color-markup marker (`\|r` red, `\|n` reset). |
| `EMOTE_SIGIL` | `'/'` | Reference sigil in rich emotes (`pose waves at /Bob`). |
| `KEYID_SIGIL` | `'$'` | Prefix of a friendly keyid reference (`get('$banknet_core')`). May not start with `#`. |
| `HEREDOC_OPEN` | `"'''"` | A line ending in this starts a multi-line block. |
| `HEREDOC_CLOSE` | `"'''"` | A line equal to this ends a multi-line block. |
| `RECURSION_LIMIT` | `1000` | Process-wide Python recursion limit (every thread, not per script). Rejected below 100 or above 100000. |
| `DB_PATH` | `'data/game.db'` | SQLite database file. |
| `WELCOME_FILE` | `'data/welcome.txt'` | Text shown on connection. |
| `WELCOME_BANNER` | `None` | Inline welcome text. When set, it wins over WELCOME_FILE. |
| `TICK_INTERVAL` | `0.1` | Seconds between server pulses (0 disables). Waits, one-shots and reapers land on it; behaviors keep their own cadence. |
| `WORLD_BEAT` | `4.0` | Seconds in one out-of-combat round (poison, regen) and the default cadence of pulse-counting behaviors. At least 0.1. |
| `REAP_INTERVAL` | `5.0` | Seconds between housekeeping sweeps (idle instances, wilderness cells, expired objects). |
| `FLUSH_INTERVAL` | `30.0` | Seconds between saves of changed objects to the database. |
| `FEATURES` | `'realm.std.CLASSIC'` | The features this game is made of, by name or module path, or a dotted path to such a list. Unset, every built-in feature (`realm.std.CLASSIC`). A game lists its own module too: `FEATURES = [*CLASSIC, "game"]`. |

## Keys declared by built-in features

A feature can declare its own keys. These exist only when the feature is in
`FEATURES` (all of them are by default).

| Key | Feature | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMBAT_RULESET` | `combat` | `None` | Combat ruleset name. Unset, the game system picks its own; set it only to mix systems on purpose. |
| `SHOW_ROLLS` | `combat` | `False` | Show dice detail on combat messages. Players override with `showrolls on\|off`. |
| `COMBAT_BEAT_MIN` | `combat` | `4.0` | Shortest combat round, in seconds. |
| `COMBAT_BEAT_MAX` | `combat` | `120.0` | Longest combat round, in seconds. |
| `COMBAT_BEAT_DEFAULT` | `combat` | `15.0` | Default combat round, in seconds. |
| `PLAYER_DEATH` | `combat` | `'unconscious'` | What happens to a player whose vital pool is spent, unless the player sets `when_spent`: `unconscious` (falls where they are and comes round as they heal) or `respawn` (leaves a corpse of their belongings and returns home at 1 point, paying the game system's `on_death` penalty). |
| `CORPSE_LOCK_SECONDS` | `combat` | `300` | Under `respawn`, how long only the dead player (and admins) may take from their corpse. 0 leaves it open to anyone. |
| `REGEN_INTERVAL` | `vitals` | `15` | Seconds between regeneration ticks. Each tick a character out of combat regains the game system's `regen` amount of each pool below full. |
| `REST_REGEN` | `vitals` | `2` | Regeneration multiplier while resting. |
| `SLEEP_REGEN` | `vitals` | `4` | Regeneration multiplier while asleep. |

## Callbacks

Define a function with one of these names in `config.py` and the server
calls it.

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `init_world` | `async def init_world(server)`: runs once, when the database is empty. |
| `on_start` | `async def on_start(server)`: runs after the server has started. |
| `on_stop` | `async def on_stop(server)`: runs when the server stops. |
